SELECT M.VEND_CODE,
C.CODE_NM AS VEND_NM,
NULL AS VEND_NM,
M.MCN_TYPE, M.MODEL_CODE, M.MODEL_NM, M.CRT_DTM, M.CRT_CMENO, M.LSCHG_DTM, M.LS_CMENO FROM TB_CO_MODEL M
LEFT JOIN TB_CO_CODE C ON C.CODE_TYPE = #{vendorCodeType} AND C.CODE = M.VEND_CODE
M.VEND_CODE = #{s.vendCode}
AND M.MCN_TYPE = #{s.mcnType}
AND (M.MODEL_CODE LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%' OR M.MODEL_NM LIKE '%' || #{s.q} || '%')
ORDER BY M.VEND_CODE, M.MCN_TYPE, M.MODEL_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_MODEL ( VEND_CODE, MCN_TYPE, MODEL_CODE, MODEL_NM, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{vendCode}, #{mcnType}, #{modelCode}, #{modelNm}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
